name: Barbell Snatch Pull
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, take a wide overhand snatch grip, flatten your back, and lock your arms straight.
Push smoothly through the floor to lift the bar closely past your knees without shifting your back angle.
Accelerate explosively at your upper thighs by fully extending your hips, knees, and ankles while shrugging your traps high.
Guide the bar smoothly back down to the floor under control before resetting.
tips: Keep your elbows locked straight through the entire leg drive rather than bending early.
Keep the bar brushing close to your thighs so your vertical power transfers straight upward.
